entry.title: above.dev: sync catalogue with live models (MiMo V2.6, drop retired v…
entry.content:
above.dev: sync catalogue with live models (MiMo V2.6, drop retired vision route) (#7738)

* above.dev: sync catalogue with live models

Brings the above.dev provider entry back in line with what
https://api.above.dev/v1/models actually serves.

- mimo-v2.5-pro -> mimo-v2.6-pro. Xiaomi deprecated mimo-v2.5-pro and
  retires it at 10:00 Beijing time on 2026-10-21. v2.6-pro is the
  successor at identical rates (CNY 3 / 0.025 / 6 per MTok), so the
  cost block is unchanged.
- Add mimo-v2.6-flash. CNY 1 / 0.02 / 2 per MTok upstream, the lowest
  cache-read price in this provider's catalogue.
- Add mimo-v2.6-pro-ultraspeed, the commercial release of the
  UltraSpeed beta withdrawn on 2026-09-07. Priced for throughput:
  CNY 30 / 0.25 / 60 per MTok.
- Remove deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp. Retired upstream on 2026-09-22:
  deepseek-v4-flash has served DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash since 2026-09-10 and
  accepts images itself, so the separate vision route was an older model
  at a higher price for the same capability.
- deepseek-v4-flash display name -> "DeepSeek V4.1 Flash" to match the
  model actually served; the id is unchanged for compatibility.

All MiMo prices are the RMB upstream rate converted at 6.5 CNY/USD plus
the flat 10% markup this provider applies, rounded to 4dp, consistent
with the existing entries. Verified against the live endpoint on
2026-09-22. `bun run validate` passes.

* above.dev: address review, add sources and drop redundant override

- mimo-v2.6-pro-ultraspeed: add the missing leading wire comment for the
  thinking toggle, matching mimo-v2.6-flash and providers/xiaomi. Verified
  on this host 2026-09-22: thinking.type=enabled returns reasoning_content
  with non-zero reasoning_tokens, disabled returns neither.
- deepseek-v4-flash: remove the name override. It is now identical to the
  base entry models/deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash.toml, so the value is
  inherited instead.
- Add first-party source URLs to the leading header of each MiMo file for
  the rates and the retirement date, so the figures can be checked.

entry.title: Add Tempr's Mistral models (#7698)
entry.content:
Add Tempr's Mistral models (#7698)

* Add Tempr's Mistral models

The 9 models Mistral currently serves that Tempr reaches: Large 3,
Medium 3.5 and Small 4 under their dated ids and -latest aliases, its
hosted GLM-5.2 and GLM-5.3 (base_model zhipuai), and mistral-embed,
with the missing models/mistral lab file for it.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* tempr: add Mistral's Voxtral Small

voxtral-small-latest (Voxtral Small 25.07, audio input) is still a current
Mistral model: it's on Mistral's model page and in a live key's
GET /v1/models (2026-09-23). The first pass wrongly counted it as retired.
